verdict.rationale: The only on-topic hint is docs-3, which describes the synchronous endpoint as needing "no polling or webhooks." That implies the async API offers webhooks as an alternative to polling, but nothing documents how to register a callback or what fires. The SDK itself polls for you (docs-18), and a community member pointed to a polling loop in an example (comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a registrable webhook URL on transcript jobs, completion/failure event coverage, payload and security details (signing/auth headers), retry behavior, and hands-on corroboration.
